definitions: To install or place something into a position or container.
To submit or present something officially.
To spend time or effort on something.
To make a request or application.
To cause a ship or boat to enter a port or harbor.
examples: They will put in new windows next week.
She put in her resignation yesterday.
He put in a lot of hours on the project.
We need to put in a claim for the damaged goods.
The captain decided to put in at the nearest port.
